messages:
Maya: heads-up — starting a quiet cutover for eu-west-1 edge lane in ~10m. Goal: move traffic from green -> blue with small steady steps, avoid oscillation. Will follow the hold windows and canary thresholds below.

Maya: plan outline: 5% -> 25% (hold 15m) -> 60% (hold 10m) -> 100% (grace 5m). Rollback triggers: 5xx > 1% sustained for 2m OR p95 latency > baseline * 1.5.

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued by @Maya. Job id: deploy-eu-3421. Scheduled start in 8 minutes. Canary weight=5%.

Ryan: quick Q — are we pinning dedicated customers to the blue variant or letting routing override? last time we lost a few sticky sessions.

Maya: pin for dedicated yes — route flag pin=true for /dedicated/*, non-dedicated follow regular shift.

Sophie: reminder — cookie-based session stickiness TTL is 12h by default. If we flip routing, sessions on green may still land on green pool unless we drain. Recommend drain old pool connections after 60s idle.

Paul: Agreed. Add drain command after each step: `kubectl annotate svc/redwood-router traffic-drain=true --overwrite` and then `routerctl drain --pool green --grace 60`.

DevOps: adding a health-check gate to the orchestrator: stop progress if 5xx anomalous or pod restarts > 2 in 5m. I'll patch the release policy now.

Maya: deploy-bot start now please. Keep me in the loop with each weight change and the health summary.

deploy-bot: Executing shift: `routedctl shift --env=prod --region=eu-west-1 --from=green --to=blue --weight=5 --grace=120 --dry=false`

ops-bot: Canary health report @weight=5% — p50=45ms, p95=120ms, 5xx=0.07% (baseline 0.05%). No pod restarts.

Ryan: :eyes: slight 5xx bump but within tolerance. Proceed to 25%?

Maya: Proceed to 25%. hold duration 15m — monitoring dashboards pinned.

deploy-bot: Updating traffic: `routedctl shift --weight=25` — job id shift-3316543210-2.

ops-bot: Health report @weight=25% after 3m — p50=48ms, p95=130ms, 5xx=0.13% (sustained 30s). Error budget usage increased but under rollback threshold.

Sophie: Starting graceful drain on green for dedicated routes now: `routerctl drain --pool green --selector "route=dedicated" --grace 60`

Paul: note: I'm toggling cookie_unset for new cookie behavior so long-lived sessions won't break: `kong config set session.cookie.unset_after=60s` — will coordinate with ops.

DevOps: watch rule added: if 5xx > 1% for 2m OR p95 > baseline*1.5 for 3m then automatic rollback to green.

Maya: copy. If autos-rollback kicks, we do full revert and then manual postmortem. Notify support and customers page.

ops-bot: Health at 25% hold end: p50=47ms, p95=140ms (baseline 120ms), 5xx=0.22% -> still below 1% but trending.

Ryan: I'm going to pin routes for enterprise customers explicitly: `routectl pin --route /dedicated/* --variant blue --duration 24h` — now applied.

Maya: good call. Proceed to 60%.

deploy-bot: Shifting to 60% now — `routedctl shift --weight=60` job id shift-3316543210-3.

ops-bot: Health @60% after 2m — p50=52ms, p95=210ms, 5xx=1.2% — threshold breached. Triggering rollback per policy.

Maya: rollback triggered. Who wants to confirm rollback command?

Paul: I'm initiating rollback to green: `routedctl rollback --to=green --region=eu-west-1 --grace=120`

deploy-bot: Rollback job started — rollback-3316543210. Holding at green with full verification checks.

Sophie: Re-enable sticky drain and set cookie_unset back to 12h after we verify stability.

ops-bot: Post-rollback health check: p50=46ms, p95=125ms, 5xx=0.08%. Services stable.

Maya: thanks all. Postmortem owners: @Paul (routing change), @Sophie (session draining), @DevOps (gating). We'll draft a short release note: cause=p95 spike under 60% load; mitigation=rollback and revert to previous kernel optimizations on blue pool.

Ryan: also add an action to test cookie TTL interactions in staging with synthetic long sessions.

Maya: noted. I'll open a follow-up thread with the action items and timeline. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Summary: cutover aborted at 60% due to p95 spike and 5xx >1%. Rollback successful. Job ids: deploy-eu-3421, shift-3316543210-1/2/3, rollback-3316543210.

Maya: closing thread. Thanks everyone for fast turnaround.
